theorems.name: Submission.intcpt_graph_piece_lintegral_le_fibre_sum
theorems.statement: ∀ (N n : ℕ) (P : Grassmannian N n) (L : ℝ) (A : Set (Euclidean N)) (g : Euclidean N → ℝ≥0∞), 0 ≤ L → (∀ y ∈ A, ∀ z ∈ A, ‖(y - z) - Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖ ≤ L * ‖Grassmannian.project P (y - z)‖) → NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) → ∫⁻ y in A, g y ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N)) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal ((1 + L ^ 2) ^ ((n : ℝ) / 2)) * ∫⁻ a in (P.plane : Set (Euclidean N)), (∑' y : {y : Euclidean N // y ∈ A ∧ Grassmannian.project P y = a}, g y) ∂(μHE[n] : Measure (Euclidean N))
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
